Method of Attack: Use-after-free vulnerability caused by improper handling of 'vzeroupper' instruction during speculative execution
Leak sensitive data such as passwords and encryption keys at a rate of 30KB/sec per CPU core
Exploit works across virtual machines, isolated sandboxes, containers, and all OSes running on affected CPUs
Impacted Systems: All AMD CPUs built on Zen 2 architecture including Ryzen 3000 (Matisse), Ryzen 4000U/H (Renoir), Ryzen 5000U (Lucienne), Ryzen 7020, ThreadRipper 3000, and Epyc server (Rome) processors
Attack Vector: Local access to target system exploiting speculative execution flaw without requiring elevated privileges or special system calls
Indicators of Compromise: Technical write-up and public tweets by Tavis Ormandy
